rules.q: Does the request mention a missed recycling pick-up without referencing sorting or mixing of recyclable and non-recyclable items?
Does the request mention yard waste items such as a Christmas tree or use the term "yard waste"?
Does the request mention a "courtesy pick up" or specific individuals picking up items, without referencing recycling sorting or non-recyclable materials?
Does the request mention the presence of trash, junk, or debris in the yard or property?
